title: X-Caret System - P. Beddows 2003 (dye-trace sketch)
credits: X-Caret System, X'Caret, Quintana Roo: sketch map of the dye-tracing test (injection site, sampling points A, B, C; Injection Site - A = 90 m, A - B = 210 m, A - C = 310 m), in P. A. Beddows, Cave Hydrogeology of the Caribbean Yucatan Coast (PhD thesis, University of Bristol, 2003), p. 46
unverified: No cenote of the map has a position in the database (the Xcaret sistema's only cave has neither name nor coordinates), and the map is a schematic sketch with no scale bar or north arrow. Placed only by park landmarks on the satellite, which the Xcaret park has reshaped since: the map's walled square = Plaza Principal, the lagoon's north arm and its west (U-shaped) arm = the caleta's north channel and the heart-shaped lagoon. Residuals 16-25 m; possibly 30-50 m off at the ends.
placementWhy: Free similarity fit on three landmarks, none a cenote with a known position: the walled square drawn at the west end of the road (the Injection Site road) on the walled courtyard building of the Xcaret park's Plaza Principal; the top of the lagoon's stippled north arm (where B is) on the north end of the caleta's narrow north channel (by La Isla); the west tip of the lagoon's U-shaped west arm on the west end of the heart-shaped lagoon (Xcaret Waterpark). Fit: 0.99 m/px, rotated 5 deg, residuals 16, 20 and 25 m. Independent check: with this scale the drawn route A - C measures about 313 m (the map says 310 m) and A - B about 190 m (210 m); Injection Site - A about 109 m (90 m). The road east from the square lands on the park's east-west walkway south of Plaza Principal (about 20 m off). The big south-west pool at the end of both western passages lands about 70 m west of the Rio Subterraneo exit pool by the coast; not used. The map shows the same caleta, Mayan wall (hatched line) and ruins as the 1979 Cueva de Xcaret map, whose cave (cenote de Felipe to the caleta) is this map's Injection Site - A - B passage.

trace.why: Schematic sketch: every passage is drawn as the same narrow double line, a symbol rather than measured walls, so it is traced as centrelines (no thickness); the double line is closed into one stroke (bridgePx) before thinning. The dashed line from the passage to B is an inferred connection: not drawn. Lagoon, ponds, pool, buildings, ruins and the road are boxed or erased out.
